questions.stem: The cash flow statement differs from the income statement most in that it:

choices.B: reports cash receipts when collected rather than when revenue is earned
choices.C: is prepared on the accrual basis

questions.explanation: Cash flow statement = cash basis (receipts when collected); income statement = accrual basis (revenue when earned).
questions.kr: 현금흐름표 = 현금주의(회수 시점), 손익계산서 = 발생주의(획득 시점).

questions.stem: The reconciliation between reported income and operating cash flow is most useful for assessing:

choices.B: when, whether, and how the company generates cash from operations

questions.explanation: The reconciliation shows when, whether, and how operations turn into cash.
questions.kr: 순이익↔영업현금흐름 조정은 영업이 '언제, 실제로, 어떻게' 현금이 되는지 보여줌.

questions.stem: Which source of cash can, in theory, continue indefinitely?
questions.explanation: Operations can continue indefinitely; asset sales last while assets last; debt lasts while lenders lend.
questions.kr: 영업은 이론상 무한, 자산 매각은 팔 자산이 있는 동안, 차입은 대출해 주는 동안만.

questions.stem: A company reports healthy sales and significant net income but collects none of its receivables. It most likely:

choices.B: has zero cash inflow and may not survive

questions.explanation: The curriculum's illustration: accrual income with zero collections → zero cash inflow → may not survive. Income is important; cash flow is also essential.
questions.kr: 교재 예시: 발생주의 이익은 있지만 회수 0 → 현금 유입 0 → 생존 불가. 이익도 중요, 현금흐름도 필수.

questions.stem: Under US GAAP: purchase of a building 500,000; proceeds from sale of machinery 60,000; gain on sale of machinery 15,000; dividends received 8,000; repayment of bonds 100,000. Net cash from investing is closest to:
questions.explanation: Strike non-cash: the GAIN (15,000). Label: dividends received → operating (US GAAP); bond repayment → financing. Investing = −500,000 + 60,000 = −440,000. B adds the gain back in (−500,000 + 60,000 + 15,000); C puts dividends received in investing (an IFRS choice, not US GAAP).
questions.kr: 비현금 제거: 처분'이익' 15,000. 분류: 배당 수취 → 영업(US GAAP), 사채 상환 → 재무. 투자 = −500,000 + 60,000 = −440,000. B는 이익을 더함, C는 배당 수취를 투자로(IFRS 선택지).

questions.stem: A company finances inventory purchases by delaying payment to suppliers. The resulting increase in accounts payable is classified as:
questions.explanation: Indirect borrowing through accounts payable is OPERATING, not financing. Only borrowing from creditors (banks, bondholders, notes) is financing.
questions.kr: 매입채무를 통한 간접 차입은 '영업'. 은행·사채·어음 차입만 재무.

questions.stem: A manufacturer buys and sells equity securities held for trading. Those cash flows are classified as:

choices.B: operating, regardless of the company's primary business

questions.explanation: Dealing/trading securities → operating for ANY company. Securities held as investments (not trading) → investing.
questions.kr: 단기매매 증권은 '모든' 회사에서 영업. 투자 목적 보유 증권은 투자.

questions.stem: Under IFRS, interest paid may be classified as:
questions.explanation: IFRS: PAID items → operating or financing (cost of capital); RECEIVED items → operating or investing.
questions.kr: IFRS: '지급' → 영업 또는 재무(자본 비용), '수취' → 영업 또는 투자.

questions.stem: Under US GAAP, which is NOT classified as an operating cash flow?
questions.explanation: NOT stem → T/F each. Interest paid: operating (T). Dividends received: operating (T). Dividends paid: FINANCING — the one US GAAP exception (answer).
questions.kr: NOT 지문 → T/F. 이자 지급: 영업(T). 배당 수취: 영업(T). 배당 지급: '재무' — US GAAP 유일한 예외(정답).

questions.stem: A company issues common stock to settle a convertible bond. In the cash flow statement this is most likely:

choices.A: a financing inflow and a financing outflow of equal amounts
choices.B: excluded from the statement and disclosed in a note or supplementary schedule

questions.explanation: No cash moves → not in the statement. Significant non-cash investing/financing transactions are DISCLOSED in a note or supplementary schedule.
questions.kr: 현금 이동 없음 → 현금흐름표 제외. 중요한 비현금 투자·재무 거래는 주석이나 보충 명세에 '공시'.

questions.stem: Under US GAAP, a company issues a 90-day note for 50,000 and uses the cash to pay wages. Cash flow from operations:
questions.explanation: Two legs: note issued → FINANCING +50,000; wages paid → OPERATING −50,000. A short-term note is still financing.
questions.kr: 두 거래: 어음 발행 → '재무' +50,000, 임금 지급 → '영업' −50,000. 단기 어음도 재무.

questions.stem: Under IFRS, a company that classifies dividends paid as operating must:

choices.B: apply the classification consistently and disclose the amount separately
choices.C: reclassify it as financing the following year

questions.explanation: IFRS choices require consistency year to year and separate disclosure of interest and dividends received and paid.
questions.kr: IFRS 선택 시 매년 일관 적용 + 이자·배당 수취/지급액 별도 공시.

questions.stem: Compared with the indirect method, the direct method most likely results in:

choices.C: a different presentation of investing activities

questions.explanation: CFO amount is identical; only the operating section's format differs. Investing and financing are presented the same.
questions.kr: 영업현금흐름 금액 동일, 영업 부분 형식만 다름. 투자·재무 표시 동일.

questions.stem: The indirect method best shows:

choices.A: the specific sources of operating cash receipts
choices.B: the reasons for differences between net income and operating cash flow

questions.explanation: Indirect: reasons NI ≠ CFO (and mirrors forecasting). A and C describe the DIRECT method.
questions.kr: 간접법: 순이익 ≠ 영업현금흐름의 이유(예측 방식과 유사). A·C는 직접법.

questions.stem: Under US GAAP, a company using the direct method must also:

choices.A: present a reconciliation of net income to cash flow from operations
choices.B: restate prior years using the indirect method
choices.C: disclose direct-format cash flows in the notes

questions.explanation: Direct filers under US GAAP must also present the NI → CFO reconciliation (= the indirect method).
questions.kr: US GAAP 직접법 사용 시 순이익 → 영업현금흐름 조정표(간접법)도 제시.

questions.stem: Analysts and commercial lenders generally prefer the direct method because it:

choices.A: is easier and less costly to prepare
choices.B: provides receipts and payments information useful for assessing capacity to repay

questions.explanation: Direct gives specific sources and uses of operating cash — useful for financing needs and repayment capacity. A is the PREPARERS' argument for indirect; C is false.
questions.kr: 직접법은 영업현금의 구체적 원천·사용을 보여 상환능력 평가에 유용. A는 작성자의 간접법 선호 이유, C는 거짓.

questions.stem: IFRS and US GAAP most accurately:

choices.B: encourage the direct method but permit either

questions.explanation: Both ENCOURAGE direct, PERMIT either; most companies use indirect.
questions.kr: 둘 다 직접법 '권장', 둘 다 '허용'; 대부분 간접법 사용.

questions.stem: The indirect method adjusts net income for all of the following EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: EXCEPT → T/F. Three adjustment types: non-cash items (T), non-operating items, changes in operating accruals (T). Debt proceeds are a FINANCING cash flow, not an adjustment to NI (answer).
questions.kr: EXCEPT → T/F. 조정 3종: 비현금 항목(T), 비영업 항목, 영업 발생액 변동(T). 차입금은 재무 현금흐름이지 순이익 조정이 아님(정답).

questions.stem: Unilever adds back €1,667m of taxation and later deducts €2,164m of income tax paid. Its 2017 cash outflow for taxes is:
questions.explanation: Tax EXPENSE (1,667) is added back; the CASH paid (2,164) is deducted. The cash outflow is 2,164. C is the difference.
questions.kr: 법인세'비용' 1,667은 가산, '현금' 지급 2,164는 차감. 현금 유출은 2,164.

questions.stem: In an indirect-method statement, an investor's share of a joint venture's profit is:

choices.B: deducted from net income, with cash dividends from the JV reported separately
choices.C: reported as an investing inflow at the same amount

questions.explanation: Equity-method income is in NI but isn't cash → deducted. Cash dividends from the JV are reported separately (Unilever: investing).
questions.kr: 지분법 이익은 순이익에 포함되지만 현금 아님 → 차감. JV로부터의 현금 배당은 별도(Unilever: 투자).

questions.stem: A company reports a €300m gain on disposal of PP&E with proceeds of €500m. Under the indirect method the gain is:
questions.explanation: Gain raised NI but isn't operating cash → deduct. The full PROCEEDS (500) go in investing. C reports the carrying value, not the cash.
questions.kr: 처분이익은 순이익을 늘렸지만 영업현금 아님 → 차감. 처분대가 '전액'(500)이 투자. C는 장부가를 기록.

questions.stem: Unilever's operating cash flow exceeded net profit each year most likely because of:
questions.explanation: Depreciation (≈ €1.5bn) is a non-cash expense added back. Borrowings and buybacks are financing — they don't touch CFO.
questions.kr: 감가상각(약 15억 유로)은 비현금비용으로 가산. 차입·자사주는 재무 — 영업현금흐름 무관.

questions.stem: If Unilever reported under US GAAP instead of IFRS, its net cash from operating activities would most likely be:

choices.A: higher, because interest paid would move to financing
choices.B: lower, because interest paid (€470m) and interest received (€154m) would both be in operating

questions.explanation: US GAAP: interest paid and received are both operating. Unilever paid 470 and received 154 → operating would fall by net 316.
questions.kr: US GAAP: 이자 지급·수취 모두 영업. 지급 470, 수취 154 → 영업이 순 316 감소.

questions.stem: Unilever 2017: CFO 7,292; investing (5,879); financing (1,433); beginning cash 3,198; FX effect (9). Ending cash is closest to:
questions.explanation: Net from activities = 7,292 − 5,879 − 1,433 = −20. End = 3,198 − 20 − 9 = 3,169. A (3,178) ignores the FX line; C (3,189) ignores the activities. FX is a separate reconciling item — include it.
questions.kr: 활동 합계 = −20. 기말 = 3,198 − 20 − 9 = 3,169. FX 효과는 별도 조정 항목으로 반드시 포함.

questions.stem: Unilever's ~€5bn share repurchase in 2017 was funded in part by:
questions.explanation: Short-term borrowing (+2,695) and additional financial liabilities (+8,851) exceeded repayments (2,604) — buybacks were partly debt-funded.
questions.kr: 단기차입(+2,695)과 추가 금융부채(+8,851)가 상환(2,604)을 초과 — 자사주는 일부 차입으로 조달.

questions.stem: An operating section that begins with 'cash received from customers' and has no depreciation line is most likely prepared using:
questions.explanation: Cash received/paid lines and no add-backs → DIRECT. Depreciation in the operating section → indirect.
questions.kr: 현금 수취/지급 항목, 가산 조정 없음 → '직접법'. 영업 부분에 감가상각이 있으면 간접법.

questions.stem: Telefónica reports net interest paid in operating; Unilever reports interest paid in financing. Both are:

choices.C: required to restate under US GAAP rules

questions.explanation: IFRS permits interest paid in operating OR financing — both comply; cross-company CFO comparisons need adjusting.
questions.kr: IFRS는 이자 지급을 영업 '또는' 재무로 허용 — 둘 다 적법. 회사 간 비교 시 조정 필요.

questions.stem: Telefónica 2017: CFO 13,796; investing (10,245); financing (1,752). Net cash from the three activities, excluding exchange-rate effects, is closest to:
questions.explanation: 13,796 − 10,245 − 1,752 = 1,799. 1,456 includes the FX and consolidation effects — not what was asked.

questions.stem: Telefónica's largest investing expenditure in each of 2015–2017 was:

choices.B: payments for PP&E and intangible assets

questions.explanation: PP&E and intangibles (≈ €9–10bn/yr) — a capital-intensive telecom network. Acquisitions were large only in 2015 (~€3.2bn).
questions.kr: 유형·무형자산(연 90~100억 유로) — 자본집약 통신망. 인수는 2015년만 큼(약 32억).

questions.stem: In 2015 Telefónica issued €4.2bn of equity yet reported negative financing cash flow, most likely because:

choices.B: debt repayments significantly exceeded new borrowing

questions.explanation: Repayments (3,805 + 9,858 = 13,663) exceeded new debt (1,602 + 8,784 = 10,386), plus dividends of 2,775.

questions.stem: Tech Data uses the direct method under US GAAP. It must therefore also present:

choices.A: a reconciliation of net income to net cash from operating activities

questions.explanation: US GAAP direct → must add the NI → CFO reconciliation.
questions.kr: US GAAP 직접법 → 순이익 → 영업현금흐름 조정표 추가 필요.

questions.stem: In an indirect-method reconciliation, an increase in accounts receivable of 500 is:
questions.explanation: Operating ASSET ↑ → SUBTRACT (sales booked but cash not collected). Assets opposite.
questions.kr: 영업'자산' ↑ → '차감'(매출 인식했으나 미회수). 자산은 반대 방향.

questions.stem: An increase in accounts payable of 1,700 is, in the NI → CFO reconciliation:
questions.explanation: Operating LIABILITY ↑ → ADD (expense booked, cash not yet paid). Liabilities same.
questions.kr: 영업'부채' ↑ → '가산'(비용 인식, 현금 미지급). 부채는 같은 방향.

questions.stem: Net income 200; depreciation 50; increase in inventory 80; decrease in accounts receivable 30; increase in accrued liabilities 20. CFO is closest to:
questions.explanation: 200 + 50 − 80 (asset ↑) + 30 (asset ↓) + 20 (liability ↑) = 220. B flips the receivables sign; C adds everything.
questions.kr: 200 + 50 − 80(자산 ↑) + 30(자산 ↓) + 20(부채 ↑) = 220. B는 매출채권 부호 반대, C는 모두 더함.

questions.stem: The provision for losses on receivables in an indirect-method reconciliation is:

choices.B: added back, because it is a non-cash expense

questions.explanation: Bad-debt expense lowered NI with no cash outflow → add back.
questions.kr: 대손상각비는 현금 유출 없이 순이익 감소 → 가산.

questions.stem: Under US GAAP, Tech Data's net interest paid is reported in:

choices.C: investing activities, if the company chooses

questions.explanation: US GAAP has no choice: interest paid is operating.
questions.kr: US GAAP는 선택 없음: 이자 지급 = 영업.

questions.stem: Tech Data's CFO did not cover investing in fiscal 2018 most likely because of:

choices.A: a large increase in property capex

questions.explanation: $2.25bn acquisition vs CFO $1.1bn. Debt repayment is financing, not investing.
questions.kr: 22.5억 달러 인수 vs 영업현금 11억. 부채 상환은 재무.

questions.stem: A company's CFO rises sharply while net income falls; the reconciliation shows a very large increase in accounts payable. This most likely suggests:

choices.A: the CFO increase may not be sustainable

questions.explanation: Delaying supplier payments brings cash in only temporarily — suppliers must eventually be paid. Payables-driven CFO is lower quality.
questions.kr: 공급자 지급 지연은 일시적 현금 — 결국 지급해야 함. 매입채무 주도의 영업현금흐름은 질이 낮음.

questions.stem: A US GAAP company using the indirect method must separately disclose:

choices.B: cash paid for interest and income taxes
choices.C: a reconciliation of net income to CFO

questions.explanation: Indirect → disclose interest and taxes paid. C is the requirement for DIRECT filers (and indirect already IS that reconciliation).
questions.kr: 간접법 → 이자·법인세 지급액 공시. C는 '직접법' 사용 시 요건.

questions.stem: Under US GAAP, which pairing of method and additional disclosure is correct?

choices.A: Direct — interest and taxes paid; indirect — NI-to-CFO reconciliation
choices.B: Direct — NI-to-CFO reconciliation; indirect — interest and taxes paid

questions.explanation: Each method supplies what the other shows: direct adds the reconciliation; indirect adds interest and taxes paid. A is the swap.
questions.kr: 각 방법은 다른 방법이 보여주는 것을 보충: 직접법 → 조정표, 간접법 → 이자·세금 지급액. A는 뒤바뀜.

questions.stem: Walmart's FY2017 reconciliation shows 'Inventories +1,021'. This means inventories:
questions.explanation: A positive adjustment on an ASSET line means the asset FELL (cash released). Assets opposite.
questions.kr: '자산' 항목의 + 조정 = 자산이 '감소'(현금 회수). 자산은 반대 방향.

questions.stem: Walmart reports a $3,136m loss on extinguishment of debt. In the cash flow statement the loss is:

choices.A: subtracted in operating; the cash paid is in investing
choices.B: added back in operating; the cash paid is in financing

questions.explanation: The loss lowered NI with no operating cash → add back. The cash paid to retire debt is FINANCING. Same structure as Example 1.
questions.kr: 손실은 영업현금 없이 순이익 감소 → 가산. 부채 상환 현금은 '재무'. Example 1과 같은 구조.

questions.stem: Net income 1,000; depreciation 400; gain on sale of equipment 60; increase in receivables 120; decrease in inventory 50; decrease in accounts payable 90; increase in accrued taxes 30. CFO is closest to:
questions.explanation: 1,000 + 400 − 60 (gain) − 120 (asset ↑) + 50 (asset ↓) − 90 (liability ↓) + 30 (liability ↑) = 1,210.

questions.stem: For many companies, including Walmart, the largest adjustment from net income to CFO is most likely:
questions.explanation: D&A — Walmart's ≈ $10.5bn, about equal to net income.
questions.kr: 감가상각비 — Walmart 약 105억 달러, 순이익과 비슷.

questions.stem: US GAAP: issuance of bonds 500; repayment of bank loan 200; dividends paid 80; interest paid 40; loss on early retirement of debt 15; purchase of treasury stock 60. Net cash from financing is closest to:
questions.explanation: Strike non-cash: the LOSS (15). Label: interest paid → operating (US GAAP). Financing = 500 − 200 − 80 − 60 = 160. B also subtracts interest; C subtracts the loss.
questions.kr: 비현금 제거: '손실' 15. 분류: 이자 지급 → 영업(US GAAP). 재무 = 500 − 200 − 80 − 60 = 160. B는 이자도 차감, C는 손실 차감.

questions.stem: Comparing the CFO of an IFRS company that classifies interest paid as financing with a US GAAP company, an analyst should most likely:

choices.B: adjust for the different classification of interest paid
choices.C: convert both to the direct method

questions.explanation: The IFRS company's CFO excludes interest paid; the US GAAP company's includes it — adjust before comparing.
questions.kr: IFRS 회사의 영업현금은 이자 지급 제외, US GAAP 회사는 포함 — 비교 전 조정.

questions.concept: Ex1 — net investing (loss is not cash)
questions.stem: A company reports: proceeds from issuing long-term debt 250,000; purchase of equipment (180,000); loss on sale of equipment 50,000; proceeds from sale of equipment 100,000; equity in earnings of an affiliate 12,000. Net cash from investing is closest to:
questions.explanation: Strike non-cash: the LOSS and the equity-method earnings. Debt proceeds → financing. Investing = −180,000 + 100,000 = −80,000. A subtracts the loss — the curriculum's planted lure; the cash is the proceeds, all of it.
questions.kr: 비현금 제거: 처분'손실'과 지분법이익. 차입 → 재무. 투자 = −180,000 + 100,000 = −80,000. A는 손실을 차감 — 교재의 함정. 현금은 처분대가 전액.

questions.stem: Under IFRS, a company issues a 120-day note for 40,000 to pay for inventory and issues long-term debt of 90,000 to pay for equipment. Operating cash flow:
questions.explanation: Inventory payment → operating −40,000. Note (+40,000) and long-term debt (+90,000) → financing. Equipment → investing. Short-term notes are financing, not operating.
questions.kr: 재고 지급 → 영업 −40,000. 어음(+40,000)·장기차입(+90,000) → 재무. 설비 → 투자. 단기 어음도 재무.

questions.stem: The three categories of activities in a cash flow statement are:
questions.explanation: Cash flows are classified by ACTIVITY: operating, investing, financing. Inflows/outflows are directions within each activity; revenues/expenses/NI are income-statement elements.
questions.kr: 현금흐름은 '활동'별 분류: 영업·투자·재무. 유입/유출은 각 활동 안의 방향, 수익·비용·순이익은 손익계산서 요소.

questions.concept: Official Q2 — sale of a building
questions.stem: Cash received from selling a building is classified as:
questions.explanation: A building is a long-term asset; buying or selling long-term assets is INVESTING. Operating = day-to-day revenue activities (selling inventory, services).
questions.kr: 건물 = 장기자산; 장기자산 매입·매각 = '투자'. 영업 = 일상적 수익 활동(재고 판매·용역).

questions.concept: Official Q3 — trading vs investment securities
questions.stem: For a manufacturer, where are (1) purchases of securities held for trading and (2) purchases of securities held for investment reported?
questions.explanation: Trading securities → OPERATING for any company; securities held as investments → INVESTING.
questions.kr: 단기매매 증권 → 모든 회사에서 '영업', 투자 목적 증권 → '투자'.

questions.stem: A $2 million convertible bond is converted into $2 million of common stock. This is most likely:

choices.A: reported as a $2 million investing inflow and outflow
choices.B: reported as a $2 million financing outflow and inflow
choices.C: disclosed as supplementary information to the cash flow statement

questions.explanation: No cash changes hands → NOT in the investing or financing sections. Significant non-cash transactions are disclosed as supplementary information (a note or schedule). B is the planted lure: it sounds like a financing event, but there is no cash.
questions.kr: 현금 이동 없음 → 투자·재무 부분에 없음. 중요한 비현금 거래는 보충 정보(주석·명세)로 공시. B는 함정: 재무 거래처럼 보이지만 현금이 없음.

questions.front: The three activities, the boundary cases, and the 'net cash from X' routine
questions.back:
O = make & sell + residual; trading securities (any company); paying A/P (trade credit is operating).
I = buy/sell long-term assets + other companies' debt/equity (short or long term), excluding trading securities.
F = raise/repay capital: stock (common/preferred), bonds, borrowing incl. SHORT-TERM notes; buybacks; repayments.
NOT CASH: gains, losses, equity-method income, depreciation, impairment.
Routine: (1) STRIKE non-cash (2) label O/I/F (3) sum the requested letter. Ex1: −200 + 120 = −80, not −150.

questions.front: IFRS vs US GAAP for interest and dividends, received and paid
questions.back:
Received: IFRS O or I | US GAAP O.
Paid interest: IFRS O or F | US GAAP O.
Dividends paid: IFRS O or F | US GAAP F.
Logic: received → alt. investing (return ON investment); paid → alt. financing (cost OF capital).
IFRS: consistent + disclosed separately. US GAAP: no choice.
Non-cash transactions (conversions, stock dividends, asset swaps): excluded, disclosed in a note.

questions.front: Same CFO; what each shows; who prefers which; standards; US GAAP mirror rules
questions.back:
CFO amount identical; only operating FORMAT differs; investing/financing same.
Direct: receipts & payments; sources of cash; analysts & lenders.
Indirect: NI + (non-cash, non-operating, accrual changes); reasons NI ≠ CFO; preparers; nearly universal.
Both standards ENCOURAGE direct, PERMIT either.
US GAAP: direct → add NI→CFO reconciliation; indirect → disclose interest & taxes paid.

questions.front: Signs for operating assets, operating liabilities, non-cash items
questions.back:
ASSETS OPPOSITE, LIABILITIES SAME.
Op asset ↑ (AR, inventory, prepaid) → subtract; ↓ → add.
Op liability ↑ (AP, accrued, taxes payable) → add; ↓ → subtract.
Non-cash expense or LOSS (depreciation, bad-debt provision, stock comp, loss on disposal/extinguishment) → add back.
Non-cash GAIN → subtract.
Read the printed sign: + on an asset line = asset fell.

questions.front: Unilever, Telefónica, Tech Data, Walmart — standard, method, interest classification, key lessons
questions.back:
UNILEVER (IFRS, indirect): tax expense 1,667 added back, tax PAID 2,164 deducted; JV income removed, JV dividends → investing; interest received → I, paid → F. CFO > NI (depreciation). 2017 buyback partly debt-funded.
TELEFÓNICA (IFRS, direct): net interest in OPERATING; largest investing = PP&E; 2015 equity raised but net debt repaid.
TECH DATA (US GAAP, direct + reconciliation): AP +1.7bn drives CFO while NI falls; acquisition → CFO < investing FY2018.
WALMART (US GAAP, indirect + interest/tax paid): D&A largest adjustment; debt-extinguishment loss added back, cash in financing.
